high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a mirror selfie in what appears to be a bathroom or dressing room. The individual is wearing a light-colored sweatshirt with a graphic design featuring characters from the movie "The Wizard of Oz." The sweatshirt includes images of Dorothy, the Cowardly Lion, the Scarecrow, the Tin Man, and the Wicked Witch of the West, along with the title "The Wizard of Oz" prominently displayed. The person has long, dark hair that is styled straight and falls over their shoulders. They are holding a smartphone with a clear case, which they are using to take the photo.
